 Official Notification: 
 Advertisement for the post of Research Assistant - Law and Economic Regulation 
Applications are invited for the post of ‘Research Assistant – Law and Economic Regulation’ on contractual basis to be associated with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India’s (MoHUA), Regional Centre for Urban Housing and Policy (RCUHP) at the NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad. 
 Requirements 
 Position: RESEARCH ASSISTANT
 No. of Positions: 02
 Qualification: Undergraduate Degree in Law or Masters in Law.
 Experience: 0-2 (Post-Qualification Experience)
 Language Proficiency: Applicants must be fluent in English.
 Location: NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad
 Remuneration: ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated)
 Application Deadline: 28 November 2026
 Tenure: Initially for one year, extendable based on performance and availability of grants.
 Scope of Work: Research and Field Work. 
 NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad (NALSAR) 
NALSAR University of Law is an institution that aims to provide quality legal education that underlines constitutionalism, rule of law and justice, with a particular focus on social justice to the marginalised communities. NALSAR imparts legal education, promotes research and training, writing and publication, in order to disseminate information and promote legal literacy. 
 How to Apply 
Applications are accepted only through the online application form available at the link provided below. Through the online application form, interested persons will be required to upload their resumé and statement of purpose, explaining their interest and the contribution that they see themselves making through this position. The statement of purpose must not exceed 500 words. Applications along with CV, documents and published writing or articles (if any) be submitted only through this link: 
 Click Here to Apply 
 Selection Process 
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview and the successful interviewees will be required to take written test based upon which, final selection will be made. 
 General Information 
1. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum and the mere fact that a candidate possesses the same will not entitle him / her for being called for an interview.
2. The University reserves the right to restrict the candidates to be called for online interview to a reasonable number on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed; or by any other condition that it may deem fit.
3. The University may constitute a Screening Committee to scrutinize the applications and short-list the candidates.
4. Call letters for test / interview will be sent only to the short-listed candidates and no correspondence will be made with applicants who are not short-listed.
5. It would be open to the University to consider the names of suitable persons who may not have applied, but recommended by experts in their respective fields.
6. The University will have the right to relax any of the qualifications and experience.
7. Canvassing in any form on behalf of any candidate will result in automatic disqualification.
8. The Selection Committee may decide its own method of evaluating the performance of the candidates in interview and written test.
9. Incomplete applications in any respect shall not be considered.
10. No interim queries regarding test / interview / selection will be entertained.
11. University reserves the right not to fill any of the vacancies advertised, if the circumstances so warrant.
12. University will not be responsible for any technical problems in submission of application by the candidates.
13. In case of any disputes / suits or legal proceedings against the University, the Jurisdiction shall be restricted to the Courts in Hyderabad, which is the Headquarters of the University.
